what: RFD4-Proteina on Wormhole vs Blackhole, same tree, same seeds, pdl1 binder spec, thinking_medium, batch 1, default levers
grader: perf/rfd4/wh/grade.sh: perf/rfd4/e2e/grade.py per seed (designed-chain CA RMSD, WH seed k vs BH seed k; floor BH seed k vs k+1) + perf/rfd4/quality.py grade --feature binder against the calibrated binder resample floor in state/rfd4/QUALITY.json, the same instruments LAND9-12 used
reading: WH lands a median 1.09 A from BH at 256 and 2.94 A at 512, against seed floors of 24.8 and 37.5 A (ratios 0.044 / 0.078). LAND12's approved 512 stack read 6.75 A against 38.6. A trajectory rerolls on any numeric change, so per-seed misses are not the test; the pooled median against the floor plus the binder KS is, and both pass at both sizes.
